-----Original Message-----
From: PNA Shipbrokers - Singapore <pna@pnaship.com> 
Sent: Wednesday, 6 May 2026 08:19
To: pna@pnaship.com
Subject: EC India / West Africa 40000 mt Bgd Rice



FROM: PACIFIC & ATLANTIC SHIPBROKERS - SINGAPORE / (Email/Teams:
pna@pnaship.com)

**

RE: EC INDIA / WEST AFRICA - 40000 MT BGD RICE 

- 40,000 mts of bagged rice sf 48-50 wog
- load port : kakinada, ec india
- laycan 20 may / onwd (try vsl dates) 
- discharge port : 10,000 mts to banjul, gambia + 30,000 mts to dakar,
senegal
- load rate: 2,000 mts pwwd sshex eiu
- discharge rate: banjul : 2,000 mts pwwd sshex eiu / dakar : 1,500 mts pwwd
sshe eiu
- 3.75pct 


RGDS 
TONY (TEAMS: pna@pnaship.com)





--

www.avg.com
